# `ascii` standard library

The `ascii` module provides single-byte ASCII classification, case conversion,
and hexadecimal digit encoding and decoding routines. It has no dependencies,
does not allocate memory, and operates directly on integer byte values (`0..255`).

```{.dva .run}
#use ascii
```

## Function catalog

| Category | Function | Signature | Return Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Classification** | `ascii::is_ascii(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if `0 <= c <= 127` |
| | `ascii::is_digit(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if ASCII digit (`'0'..'9'`, `48..57`) |
| | `ascii::is_upper(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if ASCII uppercase letter (`'A'..'Z'`, `65..90`) |
| | `ascii::is_lower(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if ASCII lowercase letter (`'a'..'z'`, `97..122`) |
| | `ascii::is_alpha(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if ASCII letter (`'A'..'Z'` or `'a'..'z'`) |
| | `ascii::is_alnum(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if ASCII letter or digit |
| | `ascii::is_hex(c)` | `Int => <>` | Flag `<>` | True if ASCII hexadecimal digit (`0..9`, `a..f`, `A..F`) |
| **Case conversion** | `ascii::to_lower(c)` | `Int => Int` | `Int` | Converts uppercase ASCII to lowercase; other inputs unchanged |
| | `ascii::to_upper(c)` | `Int => Int` | `Int` | Converts lowercase ASCII to uppercase; other inputs unchanged |
| **Hex conversion** | `ascii::hex_value(c)` | `Int => <Int\|>` | Option `<Int\|>` | Numeric value of hex digit `0..15`, or absent `<-->` if invalid |
| | `ascii::hex_digit_lower(n)` | `Int => <Int\|>` | Option `<Int\|>` | Checked lowercase ASCII hex byte for `0 <= n <= 15` |
| | `ascii::hex_digit_upper(n)` | `Int => <Int\|>` | Option `<Int\|>` | Checked uppercase ASCII hex byte for `0 <= n <= 15` |
| | `ascii::hex_char_lower(n)` | `Int => Int` | `Int` | Lowercase ASCII hex byte (precondition: `0 <= n <= 15`) |
| | `ascii::hex_char_upper(n)` | `Int => Int` | `Int` | Uppercase ASCII hex byte (precondition: `0 <= n <= 15`) |

## Contracts & distinctions

- **Invalid-input safety**: Classification predicates return `<->` (false) for
  negative inputs and values outside their respective ASCII ranges. Case conversions
  leave negative and out-of-range inputs unchanged.
- **Unicode distinction**: `ascii::is_alpha` and `ascii::is_digit` classify only ASCII
  bytes (`'A'..'Z'`, `'a'..'z'`, `'0'..'9'`). For Unicode category classification across
  all Unicode scripts, use the `unicode` module (`unicode::is_alpha`, `unicode::is_digit`).
- **Hex conversion**: `hex_value` returns `<+ value +>` for ASCII `'0'..'9'`, `'a'..'f'`,
  and `'A'..'F'`, and `<-->` for all other inputs. `hex_digit_lower` and `hex_digit_upper`
  return `<-->` for values outside `0..15`.

## Example usage

```{.dva .run}
#use ascii
#use io

// Classification
is_d = ascii::is_digit(53) // '5'
io::out(is_d | "digit" | "not digit")

// Case conversion
lower = ascii::to_lower(65) // 'A' -> 'a'
io::out(lower)

// Hexadecimal decoding
h = ascii::hex_value(102) // 'f'
io::out(h | _ | -1)
```
